annotations.title: Favorite a game or follow a creator

description: Toggle the authenticated user's favorite/follow. Provide gameId to favorite a game, or promoterId or promoterSlug to follow a creator (the same Following list the /promoters Following tab reads). promoterSlug is the last part of a creator's page url (https://www.kineticist.com/promoters/{slug}). Calling twice removes it. Returns { success, favorited }. Acts on the caller's own Kineticist account (the signed-in member, or the API key owner). Agents that make many calls per task use up a free account's daily allowance quickly.

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

promoterId.description: Kineticist promoter (creator) UUID to follow/unfollow. Provide one of gameId, promoterId or promoterSlug.

promoterSlug.description: Creator slug, the last part of its page url. Used when you have the creator's page but not its UUID.
